score_rule: Minimum selected-screen score, not an average. All applicable mandatory visual checks pass; no extra generation is required merely to increase the numeric score.

mandatory_visual_checks.check: All exact copy and sample counts readable; no observed pseudo-text.
Repairs replace dated serif/beveled treatments with deliberate modern hierarchy, surfaces and actions.
No material collisions, clipped controls or edge crowding in selected native/phone views.
Camp Build, Storage upgrade and Survivor assignment have clear primary-action hierarchy.
Controls/icons and selected states are understandable; camp fuel icon now agrees with storage fuel.
All selected screens inspected at800px landscape width and native resolution; visual readability passed.
Current Character1 and approved winter building/fence/furnace identities remain recognizable.
Stock/cost quantities, current-versus-preview stage and survivor status/selection are coherent as proposals.
Three complementary useful treatments: world-led HUD, bright object/inventory menu and dark survivor assignment. They are not claimed as three complete interchangeable UI systems.
Illustrated camp retains two open passages, a central furnace and snow outside with no painted external road; native scene fit is untested.
Actual originals and repair histories are separately identified; native/phone evidence is hash-bound.
Claims remain static-concept-only; no performance, touch, animation, implemented economy or live screenshot claim.

cross_screen_findings: Camp concentrates management controls at the edges and keeps the compact world readable.
Storage uses a bright asymmetric building/inventory composition with legible material costs.
Survivor uses a dramatic character hero, dark backdrop and restrained assignment/state layout.
Blue/orange3D art, clear typography and cut-corner primary actions provide family resemblance while the three screen purposes remain distinct.

revision_history.reason: Dated inflated/beveled UI chrome; retained unchanged.
Old serif/browser-link styling and beveled action; retained unchanged.

publication_pending: Fresh published ref/commit/untruncated tree and new image-byte verification
freeze_rule: Immutable visual acceptance with historical rejections retained. Archive/publication requires its separate checks; no further pixel testing is necessary unless a real defect appears.
